claim: Menards kitchen cabinets, are they worth it? : r/HomeImprovement - Reddit
summary: In college I worked in shipping and receiving at Menards. I would recommend staying away from the pressed board/mdf built cabinets. They broke easily and over time the shelves will sag. Quality One was their entry brand if I remember right, but the plywood boxes always seemed to hold up better. Reply reply krista37m •
